lines.trans: You all fought like dogs.
Andrea, she is the pitbull.
You never gave up all year.
Mathias, he is the hunting dog.
An exceptional instinct.
Arlette, she is Jean Gabin.
She always takes you where she wants.
It could have been excellent without a disaster.
To fire a partner, you must prove misconduct.
Wait, what is going on here?
The serious misconduct is having lied.
I understand, I am leaving.
Such a decision is made between us!
Does everyone deserve a second chance?
From now on, we do everything together!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are
se battre = to fight, to brawl
meanings.note: se battre avec quelqu'un = to fight with someone

examples.text: Ils veulent se battre avec moi?
examples.trans: They want to fight with me?

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

meanings.en: hunt, hunting (chien de chasse = hunting dog)

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: se tenir droit(e) = to stand up straight
prendre une décision = to make a decision

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

examples.text: Elle emmène son fils à l'école.
examples.trans: She takes her son to school.

meanings.note: preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: Il n'y a rien entre nous.

meanings.note: entre toi et moi = between you and me
also alone as an exclamation: Excellent!
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen
c'est ma faute = it's my fault

meanings.en: flair, instinct, keen sense of smell

examples.trans: To have a keen nose / intuition.
A dog with a keen sense of smell.

meanings.en: ce n'est pas grave: it doesn't matter

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

meanings.en: to let go of, to drop

meanings.note: object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form
no object: je pars = I'm leaving
partir en vacances = to go on holiday

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
Qu'est-ce que tu fais à Paris?
examples.trans: What are you doing in Paris?

meanings.note: starts a question: qu'est-ce que tu fais? = what are you doing?
in a sentence with ne: je ne sais rien

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
takes a singular verb: tout le monde est là
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
informal: tu es virée = you're fired
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
